name: safeline-waf-login
description: OctoBus package for Chaitin SafeLine WAF console login (account/password) and inspection read methods, for deployments without OpenAPI/API-Token.

Chaitin_WAF_SAFELINE_LOGIN.Chaitin_WAF_S.name: login
Chaitin_WAF_SAFELINE_LOGIN.Chaitin_WAF_S.description: Login to SafeLine console with account/password and return a session token.

Chaitin_WAF_SAFELINE_LOGIN.Chaitin_WAF_S.name: get-profile
Chaitin_WAF_SAFELINE_LOGIN.Chaitin_WAF_S.description: Get current user profile (reachability + session check).

Chaitin_WAF_SAFELINE_LOGIN.Chaitin_WAF_S.name: search-detect-log
Chaitin_WAF_SAFELINE_LOGIN.Chaitin_WAF_S.description: Search attack detection logs by time range and filters.

Chaitin_WAF_SAFELINE_LOGIN.Chaitin_WAF_S.name: get-es-indices
Chaitin_WAF_SAFELINE_LOGIN.Chaitin_WAF_S.description: Get ES index info (docs count / health) for data reporting health check.
